## Invitations

The outreach activity resulted in 1322 attendances from 2096 invited people. This represents an attendance rate of 63.1 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of participation during the reporting period and distinguish the number invited from the number who attended.

The attendance result should be considered alongside the recorded contact activity. It indicates that a substantial proportion of those invited took part, while also showing that not all invitees attended. The information is presented to support routine monitoring of invitations and participation.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1744 invitees. The report records 0 reminders. These figures provide a concise account of the communication activity associated with the invitations and show the recorded level of reminder activity.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
